name: troid-shadow-2
_status: research log, not a product. ToU 14(d)(v). Fixed 2026-09-29 before any shadow-2 run (SHADOW2.md, 'Fixed before any run'). A change is a new strategy with a new journal.
_vote_note: Each lookback votes the sign of its return; the trade takes the sign of the sum. A tie (two up, two down) is no trade.
_decide_note: Decided on the close of the 20:00-24:00 UTC bar, entered at the 00:00 UTC open: 8 hours after Bitfunded's reset, never inside its 16:00-16:10 UTC settling window.
_vol_note: Volatility targeting: the stop sits stop_sigmas daily standard deviations (from vol_days of 4h log returns) from the entry, and the desk's fixed dollar risk sizes the trade at that stop, so size falls as volatility rises and the dollars at risk stay the same.
_state_note: Recorded at every entry, never used to filter: vol-of-vol (the coefficient of variation of the 30-day volatility over 90 days) against its trailing 365-day median, calm or unsettled; Bollinger width (20 bars, 2 standard deviations, over the mean) against its trailing 365-day median, compressed or expanded.
_hold_note: Bitfunded help centre, Restricted Trading Practices s.1 (firms.json hold_cap_days): 10 days for its major crypto assets, 7 for other crypto, 5 for TradFi.
